catalogue_searches.conclusion: No exact independent pre-1877 original large-scale source retrieved by these catalog/text searches; an absent hit is not evidence no sheet exists.

interpretation_rules: The 1924 JPG and 1924 GeoTIFF are two digital witnesses of the SAME CARTOGRAPHIC ORIGINAL, never two independent geodetic observations.
The Austrian precursor is attested only by class/scale on printed Romanian margin; associating it to one specific 1869–1887 survey sheet is a hypothesis until original source title/date is verified.
A regional 1862 topographic representation and a 1924 detailed copy do not furnish a named castle bastion corner in the earlier source.
A printed river bend, settlement symbol, spot height, and ruin label are not by themselves stable geodetic point marks.
No legal commune border can be deduced from a printed military sheet, and map dating is distinct from the 1877 law name dispute.
